hero.title: Your posters finally tell you everything
hero.sub: Emby Badges sticks small badges on every thumbnail: resolution, audio language, multiple versions, favorites, rating. One glance and you know what to play tonight.
prob.title: Which movie, which quality, which language?
prob.1.p: This movie exists in 1080p and 4K, which one to play? You have to open the details page to find out.
prob.2.p: French, English, original audio: you can't tell without starting playback and digging through audio tracks.
prob.3.p: With several sources, you lose track of what comes from where, and what is already a favorite.
sol.title: It's all written on the poster
sol.res.p: SD, HD, Full HD or 4K, for every available version.
sol.lang.p: French, English, Japanese or original audio. The original-language badge gets a gold outline.
sol.multi.p: A MULTI badge, or the source's initial with the VirtualLib plugin.
sol.fav.p: A heart on the titles you love.
sol.cfg.p: Position (8 choices), size, margin and opacity for each group. Every badge can be switched on or off separately.
new.title: What's new in 1.2.0
new.rating.p: The community rating shows right on the poster.
new.series.p: Badges now cover series and seasons, with cumulated episodes.
new.backdrop.p: Landscape episode thumbnails, like those in "Continue Watching" on the home screen, show their badges too.
arch.title: Under the hood
arch.intro: A discreet plugin: Emby discovers it by itself, no system setting required.
arch.3s: SkiaSharp draws the badges on the image
arch.stack: C# / .NET 6, SkiaSharp 2.88, Emby's IImageEnhancer interface. Optional TMDB API key to detect the original language.
dep.title: Install
dep.bin.p: Download EmbyBadges.dll from the releases page, copy it to the root of the Emby server plugins folder (not a subfolder), then restart Emby.
dep.cfg.p: Open Emby > Plugins > Emby Badges. Each group has its own position, size, margin and opacity. Add a TMDB key for a more reliable VO badge. After a change, clear Emby's image cache and refresh your browser.
foot: Open source project, made for people who love their media library. Version
sol.film.t: Movies: it's all on the poster
sol.film.p: Resolution, audio languages and rating show on every movie poster.
sol.series.p: Series and season posters get badges too, with the badges of their episodes combined.
